title: Machine and Colony
author: Cyrus Eastwick
blurb: Silas Villalobos, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
